subsections.name: Advanced Quadratic Equations
requirements: Do not restrict questions to root comparison.
Use squares, cubes and roots where appropriate.
Use conditions involving roots and coefficients.

subsections.name: Advanced Missing Number Series
requirements: Five plausible options with exactly one correct answer.

subsections.name: Advanced Wrong Number Series
requirements: Five plausible options with exactly one correct answer.
Keep generator extensible for additional wrong-number types supplied later.

renderer_contract.options_rule: Every Hard question must have exactly five options. The correct answer must be one of them.
renderer_contract.render_rule: When options contains five choices, render five unlabeled tappable MCQ cards.

global_input_rule.easy: No stylus/pencil/handwriting. Existing normal interaction remains.
global_input_rule.moderate: No stylus/pencil/handwriting. Existing normal interaction remains.
global_input_rule.hard: No stylus/pencil/handwriting. All three subsections are MCQ.

preservation: Do not change Moderate question content or logic.
Do not change existing analytics, timer, navigation, submission, review or result functionality unless required to fix Hard.
Do not reintroduce stylus or handwriting through any question-specific renderer.

critical_summary: Every Hard question has five tappable options.
Keep Hard difficulty advanced and exam-oriented.
